description: This Dart source file defines the AuthProvider class, which manages authentication state in a Flutter application. It handles loading and saving tokens, user login/logout, and communicates with external services such as API client, realtime service, and local storage.

classes.name: AuthProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages authentication state, persists tokens, and provides login/logout functionality, including mock mode support.

methods.name: AuthProvider._
methods.description: Private constructor initializing with API and realtime service instances.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: Factory constructor setting up API and realtime services with token getter.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Loads existing user session from local storage, optionally fetches user info if not in mock mode, and connects to realtime service.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs user login, supports mock mode by generating stub user and token, or authenticates via API. Sets user state and establishes realtime connection on success.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears tokens, user state, and disconnects from realtime service.
